objective: Build and locally validate one isolated candidate-agnostic fail-closed equivalence-certificate verifier prototype using only synthetic fixtures and reusable stable-main tooling concepts.
finding_summary: A small generic verifier can bind source/protocol/package/input/evaluator identities, canonical privilege/resource envelopes, independent producer attestations, and ordered trajectory/checkpoint digests without carrying any scientific authority.
The prototype emits only VALID_EQUIVALENT, VALID_NOT_EQUIVALENT, or INVALID_CONTRACT and fails closed on schema, binding, envelope, producer-independence, or canonicalization violations.

Seven synthetic local tests passed, covering exact match, semantic mismatch, binding mismatch, privilege drift, non-independent producers, unexpected scientific-claim field, and NaN/non-canonical resource data.
The isolated Utility branch is exactly two commits ahead of stable main and changes only the verifier module and synthetic test file; it is intentionally unmerged and non-authoritative.
